title: Bimetallic copper- and nickel-rich Cu–Ni phyllosilicate catalysts for the liquid phase selective hydrogenation of furfural to furfuryl alcohol
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38232-38244
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07162J, Paper

Tanyarat Shoosri, Pisacha Chotiwilaiwan, Tanisorn Rattanapornchaiwat, Thapong Teerawatananond, Takanori Miyake, Joongjai Panpranot, Patcharaporn Weerachawanasak
Bimetallic Cu–Ni phyllosilicates (Cu–NiPS) with various Ni/Cu ratios (5 : 15, 10 : 10, 15 : 5 wt%) were synthesized using ammonia evaporation hydrothermal method to obtain copper-rich or nickel-rich Cu–Ni alloys.
